name: elastin microfibril interfacer 2

function.text: EMILIN2 encodes EMILIN-2. Annotated molecular activities include extracellular matrix constituent conferring elasticity. It participates in positive regulation of angiogenesis and regulation of blood pressure.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, fibrosarcomatous. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: EMILIN2 encodes EMILIN-2. May be responsible for anchoring smooth muscle cells to elastic fibers, and may be involved not only in the formation of the elastic fiber, but also in the processes that regulate vessel assembly.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EMILIN2 have been reported in dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, fibrosarcomatous.
